envelope.title: Start here · the BrightMart story
envelope.body: BrightMart is a fictional online grocery retailer. Start with Easy Checkout: a payment confirmation check is blocked, two teams disagree about the Payment Gateway owner, and Green Basket Stores has a rollout promise. Other stories cover delivery tracking, refunds, stock, collection, rewards and reports. All people and records are invented. The demonstration guide explains the questions to ask; the agent answers from indexed evidence, not this guide.
